notes: GeoTalk 1.4: another fix aimed squarely at the app closing when an internet call starts. Call signaling was reworked so the calling engine is never blocked by network writes: the offer/answer and the network candidates are now written on their own dedicated signaling thread, in order, and the engine's callbacks return instantly instead of doing network work. Everything from 1.3 is kept: the engine connects first and attaches your voice only after the connection is up, proper telephony audio mode with audio focus, the safety guard that recognises a closed call from the session trail and sends the next call straight to Push-to-Talk, the update popup no longer appears after you have already updated, incoming calls ring with your default ringtone and vibration, problem reports always record the newest incident, near-instant call setup, direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
